final: WITH joined AS (SELECT oe.orderexecmark, o.ordertune FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault), type_counts AS (SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM joined GROUP BY ordertune), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM type_counts), shares AS (SELECT t.ordertune, t.cnt, CAST(t.cnt AS FLOAT) / totals.total as shr FROM type_counts t, totals), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(shr) as overall_avg FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT s.ordertune, s.cnt, s.shr, o.overall_avg FROM shares s, overall_avg o WHERE s.shr > o.overall_avg) SELECT SUM(cnt) as sum_counts, AVG(shr) as avg_share, AVG(shr - overall_avg) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
